issues.description: Method addGuestStudents: the problem statement's task text specifies the signature addGuestStudents(String) (treating the new guest count as a String), while the UML diagram in the same problem statement and the solution implementation declare addGuestStudents(int). This is a parameter-type mismatch for the same method name. A student following the textual description would implement addGuestStudents(String) and end up with a different signature than the one used in the UML and solution; automated tests or example code that call addGuestStudents(int) will not compile or will fail to link to the student's implementation, causing confusion and potential compilation failures.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the parameter type consistent across all artifacts. Change the task text in problem_statement.md (line 49) from addGuestStudents(String) to addGuestStudents(int) to match the UML and solution implementation. If the original intent was to accept a String, update the UML and solution to use String and add clear instructions on how that String should be parsed/validated. Prefer using int for a numeric student count to avoid unnecessary parsing and type confusion.
